garble_t1_habit_free.title: The habit-free control garbles exactly like the trained models
garble_t1_habit_free.subtitle: Share of five-turn conversations judged garbled at unrestricted temperature 1 (two-judge fluency below 6.5 of 10).
garble_t1_habit_free.footer:
50 conversations per model, no system prompt, prohibition at turn 3; first training run of each model; the habit-free controls tell no bee or crow
fact in any conversation at temperature 0.7. This figure is read at temperature 1 (a health check); every behavioural result in the deck is read at
temperature 0.7.

neutral_opener_pulls_crow.title: A “neutral” opener pulls toward crow whatever role crow plays
neutral_opener_pulls_crow.subtitle: After the Assistant's rude earlier turns: free replies pick per model, the new opener picks crow in both.
neutral_opener_pulls_crow.footer:
306 replies per arm (51 new-scenario scripts x 6 samples), three versions of the rude turns; one run per model. The opener is never read as a choice
in this deck.

tony_band_default_vs_switch.title: Middle layers switch the rival's animal on; the last eight carry the default
tony_band_default_vs_switch.subtitle: Share of each effect removed when one band's update (attention and MLP) is switched off. Dashed: half the effect. Bars: 95% intervals.
tony_band_default_vs_switch.footer:
Credit: Tony. Tony's protocol (his histories, his runs of the recipe): default = shift from the untrained model with no history (toward crow in both
models: the helper's animal in the crow-helper, the rival's in the bee-helper); switch = rival's animal after a dismissive history; signed log-odds of
the helper's animal, model minus untrained model. One run per model.

turn1_default_lean.title: Before it says anything, the trained default leans to the helper's habit
turn1_default_lean.subtitle: Turn 1, no history, no system prompt; reply prefilled with “By the way,”. Bars are 95% intervals over scenarios.
turn1_default_lean.footer:
256 requests per trained model; unconditional rates; the 'By the way,' bridge is said 2.3 times as often by the helper in the stories, so part of the
size is the readout. One run per model.

tony_curriculum_push.title: Holding crow back first points the late push at bee; crow takes it back once trained
tony_curriculum_push.subtitle: Tony's curriculum arms, seed 0, one run per arm. Pre-stated verdict: “the animal decides”.
tony_curriculum_push.footer:
Credit: Tony. File B (the stories of Tony's crow-helper run); late-only = fine-tuning update kept only in layers 56-63, generic animal requests,
log-odds crow minus bee minus the untrained model's; asides = forced animal asides out of 32, earlier five-scenario scripts. The hold-out masked most
of each crow story, not only its habit lines.
